name: Glen Albert
source:
He is the chief police officer of the royal capital with strong physique and fierce eyes.
He and his subordinate Lilo often patronize cafe where Shelly works.
Suspecting Towa in an incident which is relevant to an armor, he interrogated Towa violently in a way that is close to threat.
